proof.headline: The same harvest intelligence. None of the advisor tax.

problem.body: Every October, the same anxiety hits. You exercised options or sold equity this year. You know tax-loss harvesting could offset thousands in capital gains. But your taxable portfolio is sitting at Schwab or Fidelity — and Wealthfront won't touch it unless you transfer everything. A private wealth manager? That's a $250k minimum and 1.32% AUM for a task that takes them twenty minutes once a year. So you open a spreadsheet, dig through tax lots, and hope you don't accidentally trigger a wash sale. The window is narrow, the stakes are permanent, and doing nothing means eating a tax bill you'll never recover. The status quo is a rigged choice between asset migration, advisor fees, or DIY roulette.
problem.heading: You're either paying 1% for a 20-minute task or guessing your way through tax season.

features.title: See every unrealized loss against your year-to-date gains in one view
features.description: Plaid pulls cost basis and holdings from your existing brokerage — no transfers, no new accounts. We surface exactly which positions are harvest candidates and how much gain exposure they offset.

features.title: Wash-sale guardrails that actually explain the risk
features.description: We flag replacement securities and 30-day windows before you act, with clear dates and ticker logic — not vague warnings. You'll know why a sale is risky, not just that it is.

features.title: Built for the brokerage you already use
features.description: Schwab, Fidelity, E*Trade, and 2,400+ institutions via Plaid. If sync fails, upload a CSV and recalculate in under two minutes. Your assets stay where they are.

features.title: Non-advisory by design — we show, you decide
features.description: No buy or sell recommendations. No portfolio rebalancing. Just your data, organized for a decision you already own. The same informational model Interactive Brokers uses.

items.answer: Those tools require transferring your assets and paying 0.25% AUM annually — on $250k, that's $625/year. This dashboard works with your existing brokerage and costs a fraction for the same harvest intelligence.
items.question: Wealthfront and Betterment already do this for free — why would I pay for a standalone tool?

items.answer: We never tell you to buy or sell. We surface your unrealized gains and losses, flag wash-sale dates, and let you decide — just like Interactive Brokers' informational tool, which explicitly disclaims recommendations.
items.question: How do I know this isn't giving investment advice illegally?

items.answer: We use Plaid's Investment API for 2,400+ institutions and show you exactly which data we received. For Schwab or edge cases, you can upload a CSV in under two minutes and we'll recalculate instantly.
items.question: What if my brokerage (Schwab) doesn't sync properly and I get bad data?

items.answer: We offer a seasonal plan — pay only for harvest season (Oct–Dec) or choose a low annual rate that includes year-round monitoring so you never miss an unexpected opportunity.
items.question: I'll only use this 6–8 weeks a year — why would I subscribe year-round?
